candidates.review_note: Root the reconstructed unit-edge tree at the first original leaf. The attachment of a new leaf is its deepest common ancestor with any previously inserted leaf; its depth follows directly from the three pairwise distances. Ascend the selected existing path to that depth, append the remaining unit edges, and retain all degree-two subdivision vertices. Output sorted non-leaf degrees for every input dataset.

XOR decreases a number exactly when its bit at the largest hexadecimal digit is already set, since this is the highest changed bit. For each possible largest digit D, subtract bounded digit counts with alphabet0..D-1 from those with alphabet0..D, enforcing bit D in the appropriate hexadecimal position. Leading zero padding does not change any positive maximum digit; zero cannot satisfy the required bit. Prefix counts answer inclusive ranges without enumerating their numbers.
